verdict.rationale: Bolt documents a direct Stripe integration for payments and lets you add server-side edge functions from the builder through its Supabase integration. Its GitHub README also says it can run Node.js servers and interact with third-party APIs. There is no documented first-party email-sending integration: the only email evidence is email sign-up for authentication, which is a different capability. Server-side functions are documented only through the Supabase option, not as a native Bolt feature. Missing for 10: a documented email-service integration (e.g., transactional email), native server-side function docs beyond Supabase edge functions, and independent hands-on corroboration of the payment and server-function integrations working.

support.subject: As a developer, I can add server-side functions and third-party integrations like payments and email from the builder

citations.quote: Bolt integrates directly with Stripe to handle user payments and subscriptions.
Use Supabase with Bolt to add a database, authentication, or edge functions to your app as an alternative to Bolt Database.
